title: Fleet Config, Errors, SandboxID, Instance State
description:
Package: internal/sandbox/control/fleet/
Plan references: Plan 20 sections 4.1 (FleetConfig), 7 (SandboxID), 8 (Instance State Machine), 9 (Errors)
Required reading: docs/plans/00-implementation-guide.md

Merged from proposal tasks 1 and 2: FleetConfig + errors + SandboxID encoding + Instance State Machine. Task 1 alone would be too small without the instance/ package (which is owned by plan 19 epic).

Scope:
- fleet/config.go: FleetConfig struct, DefaultFleetConfig(), FleetOption type
- fleet/errors.go: ErrNoCapacity, ErrFleetClosed, error classification
- fleet/sandbox_id.go: encodeSandboxID(), parseSandboxID(), sandboxIDPrefix const, colon validation
- fleet/instance_state.go: InstanceState enum (5 values: Provisioning, Ready, Active, Draining, Terminating), ManagedInstance struct (all fields), state transition validation methods, DrainReason, ConsecutiveSuccesses/ConsecutiveFailures counters, lock ordering comments

Unit tests:
- DefaultFleetConfig() returns sensible defaults
- FleetConfig validation (min <= max instances, etc.)
- CloudInstanceState string values are stable
- sandbox_id_test.go: Round-trip encoding/parsing, missing prefix error, missing separator error, empty components error, colon-in-instanceID rejection, empty fields rejection
- instance_state_test.go: All valid state transitions succeed, invalid transitions return error, Ready->Active on first session, Active->Ready on last session destroyed, Draining->Ready recovery (health reason only), Draining->Ready rejected for scale-down/shutdown reasons

Estimated size: ~600 lines (types + tests)
Dependencies: Plan 19 task 1 (shared instance/ package for InstanceProvisioner and types)

comments.author: coder-2-sea
comments.text: Completed: fixed fleet.go compilation (created node_client.go with local FleetNodeClient/HealthCheckResult types instead of importing rpc/api), added config_test.go (8 test functions covering defaults, all validation rules, boundary values, options, joinErrors), moved RunProvisionerContractTests to contract_tests.go for cross-package visibility, removed unused struct fields to pass staticcheck. All 48 fleet tests pass, make check && make test clean.
